text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан makes a comeback.
Unfortunately,
she has lost her edge.
Hishi Amazon is shocked to
see this new
development.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing Нарита Брайан so frustrated shakes
her to
the core. Later, she heads to the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There, she catches Нарита Брайан and
Symboli
Rudolf on a partner run. Despite
the substantial
gap between the two,
Нарита Брайан doesn't give
up and
doggedly tries to close the distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite everything, Нарита Брайан is as
eager to run
as ever, and Хиши Амадзон
is confident she will
climb her way back
to the top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
